prompt: Camera steady. The man in the flat cap, lips together, lifts the framed picture a few centimetres and says to the camera, casually: Lots of pals, love. Forty quid. He speaks once, not smiling while he talks, then gives a small nod with his mouth shut. Drizzle, shoppers in hoods pass behind. Nobody else speaks.
